subject: general
question: If the sum of two numbers p and m is 12 and (p ^ 3 + m ^ 3) = 360 then find the value of pm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct identity: **p³ + m³ = (p + m)³ − 3pm(p + m)**

Substitute the given values: 360 = 12³ − 3pm(12)

360 = 1728 − 36pm

36pm = 1728 − 360 = 1368

pm = 1368 ÷ 36 = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers (p + m) = 12

Sum of their cubes (p³ + m³) = 360

**Formula Used:**

Algebraic identity: (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (p + m)³ = p³ + m³ + 3pm(p + m)

⇒ (12)³ = 360 + 3 × pm × 12

⇒ 1728 = 360 + 36pm

⇒ 36pm = 1728 − 360

⇒ 36pm = 1368

⇒ pm = 1368 ÷ 36

⇒ pm = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Factorization

The identity a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) can also be used to find the sum of cubes.

Difference of Cubes Identity

For subtraction, the identity is a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

Algebraic Relationships

Using p + m and pm, one can also find p² + m² using (p + m)² − 2pm.</p
